statement: A compliance officer needs the date from which MiCA applies, and whether any parts of it apply earlier.
A crypto-asset service provider (for example a crypto exchange) wants to pay customers a return for keeping a euro-pegged stablecoin on its platform. Is that allowed under MiCA?
An investment firm has suffered a major ICT-related incident. Under DORA, within what time must it send the initial notification to its competent authority?
gap_note: The time limits are set by the regulatory technical standards mandated by DORA Article 20, first paragraph, point (a)(ii); Level 2 acts are not in the corpus.
